title: Letters and Postcard
author: Beatrix Sandoval
blurb: Bram Reyes, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
